subject: Intro & AWS co-sell demo: OrbitEdge x Redwood Inference
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@orbitedge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & AWS co-sell demo: OrbitEdge x Redwood Inference

Hi Priya —

Great to connect at re:Invent follow-up — glad you and the OrbitEdge team are interested in a joint demo with AWS. We’d love to run an abbreviated co-sell walkthrough focused on how Redwood Inference appears in the AWS Marketplace + a short technical demo of the Dedicated deployment and integration patterns for multi-tenant SI workflows.

Proposed format (45–60m):
- 10m quick intros & objectives
- 20m demo (marketplace listing, deployment options, simple integration example)
- 15m Q&A / next steps (procurement & mutual action plan)

Proposed time windows next week (PDT):
- Tue 2026-07-14 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2026-07-15 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00

If those don’t work, tell me what works for you and we’ll accommodate. I’m looping in Karthik (partner lead) to help with logistics and Vanessa (Solutions Engineer) will be the primary demo SE — I’ll add her once we lock a time.

Attaching a very short deck with the suggested agenda and a 1-page checklist for marketplace co-sell (orbitedge-redwood-demo-deck.pdf, initial-agenda.md).

Thanks — excited to align.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment stubs: orbitedge-redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 2.9MB), initial-agenda.md (Markdown, 3KB)

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & AWS co-sell demo: OrbitEdge x Redwood Inference

Ben —

Thanks, this looks great. We’re excited to see how Redwood appears in the Marketplace and to validate the Dedicated workflow for our managed deployments. Quick notes from our side:
- We can do Tue 2026-07-14 but only after 13:00 PDT (we have onsite customer sessions in the morning).
- Wed 2026-07-15 works best between 15:00–16:00 PDT.
- Please include Michael Chu (our AWS co-sell SE) — he’ll join if the time works. I’ve cc’d OrbitEdge Sales for scheduling.

Also can you confirm: will the demo include a short deployment on an AWS account (staging) or will it be screen-share only? We’d prefer a quick sanity deploy if feasible (5–10m) so customers can see Marketplace flow + the Dedicated provisioning UX. If not possible, screen-share is fine.

Looking forward — Priya
Priya Rao
Head of Solutions, OrbitEdge
priya@orbitedge.io | +1 (206) 555-0913

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & AWS co-sell demo: OrbitEdge x Redwood Inference

Priya —

Thanks for the quick response and the time options. Wed 2026-07-15 15:00–16:00 PDT works for our team. I’ve added Michael from AWS and looped in Vanessa (SE) and Karthik (partner manager) on this thread so they have visibility.

A few logistics so we’re aligned:
- Format: 50m total (10m intros/objectives, 25m demo including a short Marketplace provisioning demo, 15m Q&A + procurement/next steps).
- Environment: Vanessa will do a staged provisioning against a Redwood demo AWS account (screen-share) and, time-permitting, we can show a 1-click Marketplace ordering flow.
- Pre-reqs: no infra changes required from OrbitEdge — screen-share only. If your customer wants hands-on access, we can follow up with a sandbox account after the session.

Attachments: I’m re-attaching the deck and a one-pager logistics note. I’ll also send a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) once we confirm.

If that all looks good, can someone from OrbitEdge confirm headcount and if you want a short customer-facing slide added?

Cheers —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Lead | Redwood Inference

Please add anything customer-facing to the deck if convenient — we’ll want one slide showing how OrbitEdge will package Redwood for managed deployments. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/OrbitEdge (for reference when you update the mutual action plan).

See you on Wed — Priya
